product_goal: Provide a reliable AI-assisted utility with a deterministic core workflow and scoped explanations.
target_users: People in Japan who need a focused self-service utility
primary_user_journey: Open the public tool and provide the required inputs
Optionally ask the AI for a scoped explanation
Save the result after signing in

architecture.data_strategy: Managed per-user persistence with server-side authorization

release_acceptance: Mobile and desktop visual QA pass
No release-blocking security, privacy, accessibility, or SEO issue remains
